description: Implement the core moment-to-moment gameplay: first-person player movement + camera, health, the weapon system with knife->gun progression (melee + ranged with ammo/reload), zombie AI (wander/chase/attack/die), combat resolution, weapon/ammo pickups, and the live HUD. Depends on FEAT-001 scaffold.
steps: Create js/entities/Player.js: FP controller using PointerLockControls object as the camera rig. WASD movement relative to look direction, Shift to run, gravity + ground clamp, simple AABB/sphere collision against zone colliders. Fields: health (0-100), maxHealth, inventory (weapons owned), currentWeapon, damage/hit feedback (screen flash + audio). Methods: update(dt,input,zone), takeDamage(n) (LOSE when health<=0), heal(n), giveWeapon(type), switchWeapon(index). Attach a first-person weapon viewmodel from AssetFactory.

Create js/entities/Weapon.js: model both weapons via a small config. Knife: melee, short range, arc/cone hit test against zombies+NPCs in front, cooldown, swing animation + swing sfx. Gun: ranged hitscan via THREE.Raycaster from camera, ammo + reserve ammo, reload, muzzle flash, gunshot sfx. attack(scene, targets) returns hit results; expose ammo/clip for HUD. Player starts owning ONLY the knife (per story: 'just a small knife in her room').

Create js/entities/Zombie.js: mesh from AssetFactory.makeZombie(); state machine IDLE/WANDER/CHASE/ATTACK/DEAD. Detects player within a radius, paths straight toward player (with simple separation to avoid perfect stacking), attacks on contact dealing damage on a cooldown, has health, plays growl occasionally, and on death plays death sfx + is removed/ragdoll-collapsed and counted toward kills. Provide update(dt, player) and takeDamage(n).

Wire combat in Game loop: player attack -> Weapon queries nearby zombies/NPCs -> applies damage -> zombies die and increment kill count. Zombies damage player on contact. Maintain an array of active zombies per zone.

Add pickups: AssetFactory.makePickup('gun'|'ammo'|'medkit'); when player is within range and presses E (or on touch), grant the item (gun unlocks ranged weapon and enables knife->gun progression; ammo adds rounds; medkit heals), play pickup sfx, remove pickup, show HUD toast.

Create js/ui/HUD.js: bind DOM from index.html. Render health bar, current weapon name + icon, ammo/clip (hidden for knife), current objective text, and a transient message/toast API showMessage(text,ms). Update every frame from Game state. Also render a damage vignette when hit and a death/again prompt hook.

Update Game.debugState() to report real player.health, current weapon, ammo, and live zombieCount. Add a headless test hook: window.__GAME__.test = { spawnZombie(), attack(), killAllZombies(), giveGun() } so the verification harness can exercise combat without real mouse input.

Run node --check on all files, then headless-verify: load game, call window.__GAME__.test.spawnZombie() then window.__GAME__.test.attack()/killAllZombies() and giveGun(), assert zombieCount decreases, weapon switches to gun after giveGun+switch, and no console errors. Screenshot to artifacts.
git add and commit: 'feat: player movement, weapon progression (knife->gun), zombie AI, combat, pickups, HUD'.
acceptance_criteria: Player moves with WASD and looks with the mouse (pointer lock) without console errors.
Player starts with only a knife; picking up the gun unlocks ranged combat and switching weapons (keys 1/2) works.
Knife melee and gun hitscan both damage and kill zombies; killed zombies are removed and the kill/zombie count updates in debugState().
Zombies chase the player and reduce player health on contact; health reaching 0 transitions Game state to LOSE.
HUD shows health, current weapon, ammo (for gun), and current objective, and updates live.
window.__GAME__.test hooks (spawnZombie, attack, killAllZombies, giveGun) work headlessly and window.__consoleErrors stays empty.
node --check passes for all js files.
verification: for f in $(find js -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || echo FAIL:$f; done

cd /projects/sandbox/Games && python3 -m http.server 8099 >/tmp/h.log 2>&1 & SRV=$!; sleep 2; agent-browser --session v2 open 'http://localhost:8099/index.html'; agent-browser --session v2 wait 3000; agent-browser --session v2 eval 'window.__GAME__.test.spawnZombie(); window.__GAME__.debugState().zombieCount'; agent-browser --session v2 eval 'window.__GAME__.test.giveGun(); window.__GAME__.test.killAllZombies(); JSON.stringify(window.__GAME__.debugState())'; agent-browser --session v2 eval '(window.__consoleErrors||[]).join(" | ")||"NO_ERRORS"'; agent-browser --session v2 screenshot /projects/sandbox/.kiro/artifacts/screenshots/feat002-combat.png; kill $SRV
findings: Implemented Player.js (FP controller on the PointerLockControls rig), Weapon.js (knife melee cone + gun hitscan), Zombie.js (IDLE/WANDER/CHASE/ATTACK/DEAD AI), HUD.js (live health/weapon/ammo/objective + damage vignette), and wired combat + pickups (gun/ammo/medkit, grabbed via E or proximity) into the Game loop. Key notes for later features: (1) In vendored three r160 PointerLockControls exposes `.camera` and `getObject()` but NOT `.object`; the movement RIG IS THE CAMERA itself (controls mutate camera.position directly). Player.rig falls back to this.camera, and Player.group.position = rig.position minus EYE_HEIGHT(1.7) to give feet position for zombie targeting/pickups. (2) debugState now reports real player.health, current weapon type, gun ammo (0 for knife), live zombieCount (alive only), and kills. (3) Test hooks added: window.__GAME__.test = { spawnZombie(x,z), attack(), killAllZombies(), giveGun() }. Also exposed window.__GAME__.spawnZombie() and _beginPlay() usable headlessly. (4) Player starts with ONLY the knife per story; giveWeapon('gun') sets hasGun and auto-equips index 1; weapon keys 1/2 map to inventory index 0/1. (5) Zombie death: alive=false + 1.2s collapse animation, then removed from zone.zombies and zone.group in the Game loop. (6) HUD lazily injects a #damage-vignette div (not in index.html) styled inline. Verified headlessly: spawn -> zombieCount rises to 3; knife attack on a zombie placed in look direction returns 1 hit; giveGun+switch -> weapon 'gun', ammo 12; killAllZombies -> zombieCount 0, kills 3; player.takeDamage(9999) -> state LOSE; window.__consoleErrors stayed empty (NO_ERRORS) throughout; node --check passed for all js files. Screenshot at /projects/sandbox/.kiro/artifacts/screenshots/feat002-combat.png. Confirmed the FEAT-001 env findings: NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared for node --check, background server + agent-browser must be one chained shell command, and the /Pointer Lock/i console-error filter in main.js must stay intact.
